input: Unfair discrimination and misrepresentation is a risk associated with An image processing algorithm is designed to automatically crop photos, focusing on the most prominent features within the image. The algorithm aims to identify and prioritize specific faces or objects, adjusting the crop accordingly. This task requires the algorithm to analyze and make decisions about the visual content of the image.
